lines.1: 「Well, I've got track practice tomorrow morning, so I'm heading home.」
lines.3: 「I'll head out too. I'll be back tomorrow night.」
lines.5: 「Hey, Crab. Everyone's gone. You should go home too.」
lines.12: 「Your body's so soft... You really are a girl.」
lines.14: I gently carried her out of the room in my arms like a princess.
